biography.value:
CAELNOR — level 3 PC pregen, Aelrathil sun-elf lightweaver, slave escapee. Light-starved by captivity; one flare of the sun-gift left.

Spellcasting (CHA, caster level 3, 2× 1st-level slots): Sacred Flame, Light, Guiding Bolt, Healing Word — attached and automated.

Manual: Fey Ancestry — advantage on saves vs. being charmed, magic can't put him to sleep.

abilities.name: Last Light
abilities.desc: The last spark of the sun-gift flares. One creature within 30 ft makes a DC 13 Constitution save or is blinded for 1 round and takes 2d6 radiant damage (nothing on a success). The flash also lights the area for a round. 2/day.

abilities.name: Sharpened Tally-Stake
abilities.desc: A splintered ore-marker honed to a point. Melee weapon attack: 1d6+3 piercing on a hit.
